name: Jayanti Rath/ଜୟନ୍ତୀ ରଥ

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Jayanti Rath’s writing spans Odia fiction, poetry and historical research. Her work in cultural institutions includes service as superintendent of the Odisha State Museum, where she took part in the launch of its online manuscript catalogue in 2014. Sahitya Akademi records her participation in Odia short-story readings and publishes her monograph on the historian Satya Narayana Rajguru.

In “ଅକ୍ଷର ଆଳାପ,” the difficulty of speaking becomes a difficulty of reading the world. A leafless tree laden with fruit, letters scattered through branches and sky, and a fading dream make an inward disquiet visible. The poem holds the speaker’s solitude against the lost intimacy of conversation with words.
